== Notes ==
* Unlike all other skills that "steal" skills, this does not [[disable]] the corresponding original and instead is placed as a [[skill icon]] in the [[Effects Monitor]]. When you hover over the skill icons of elite spells in the Effects Monitor, their skill descriptions will appear to have effects based on their normal ranks, but the Fast Casting rank will be used when the spells are cast.
* Symbols of Inspiration will only recharge normally if no skill was copied. If a skill was copied, Symbols of Inspiration is [[disable]]d for 15 seconds after the copy effect ends.
* All elite spells on your skill bar will use your Fast Casting attribute rank even if they were obtained by other means, such as [[Arcane Mimicry]], [[Arcane Thievery]] or [[Signet of Capture]]. This will work with skills linked to title tracks, specifically [[Norn rank|Norn]] [[Form]]s.
